code.basis: repository LICENSE header; not a weights/data license

name: TipTour
notes: JEV mode sends the typed task, locally detected labels and positions, and action history to TypeSafe's hosted jev-latest model (api.typesafe.ai); it performs only clicks and stops after 12 actions. Gemini mode receives microphone audio and, when enabled, screenshots. Video tours are built by the Elorian service and only point at controls. The localhost harness on 127.0.0.1:19474 exposes observe, ground-target and act endpoints. Requires macOS 14.2+ and an Xcode build; the repository has no releases. The MIT LICENSE also credits Farza's Clicky, the upstream fork source; bundled Neko sprites carry a BSD-2-Clause file. Code was read, not run.
summary: macOS menu-bar agent that grounds clicks with a local Core ML control detector and accessibility tree, driven by TypeSafe's JEV text loop or Gemini realtime voice, with a localhost harness for other agents.
